name: @pipeworx/mcp-greynoise

tools.name: ip_context
tools.description: Classify an IPv4 address using the GreyNoise Community dataset (BYO API key). Returns: noise (mass internet scanner?), riot (known-good service like Google/AWS?), classification (malicious|benign|unknown), entity name, last-seen date, and a viz.greynoise.io deep link for SOC triage.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-greynoise forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the greynoise pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
